say:1:1710503001:1.text: I've got all kinds. Lilies, roses, forget-me-nots...
say:1:1710503001:1.male: I've got all kinds. Lilies, roses, forget-me-nots...
say:1:1710503001:1.female: I've got all kinds. Lilies, roses, forget-me-nots...

say:4:1710503003:1.text: The cemetery? Just follow this road straight out toward the outskirts.
say:4:1710503003:1.source_cn: 维纳尔墓园吗？您可以沿着这条通往城郊的路直走。
say:4:1710503003:1.male: The cemetery? Just follow this road straight out toward the outskirts.
say:4:1710503003:1.female: The cemetery? Just follow this road straight out toward the outskirts.

say:5:1710503004:0.text: You'll reach a small fork. Take the narrow path leading in.
say:5:1710503004:0.source_cn: 直到小的岔路口，那是通往墓园的小路，您可以从那里进入。
say:5:1710503004:0.male: You'll reach a small fork. Take the narrow path leading in.
say:5:1710503004:0.female: You'll reach a small fork. Take the narrow path leading in.

say:6:1710503005:0.text: It's not very big, and there aren't many people buried there. It's usually pretty quiet.
say:6:1710503005:0.source_cn: 维纳尔墓园不太大，埋葬的人也不多，平时挺冷清的。
say:6:1710503005:0.male: It's not very big, and there aren't many people buried there. It's usually pretty quiet.
say:6:1710503005:0.female: It's not very big, and there aren't many people buried there. It's usually pretty quiet.

say:7:1710503006:0.text: Though... well, it has a bit of a reputation.

say:9:1710503007:1.source_cn: 嗯……听说那里夜晚偶尔会闹鬼呢。而且那里有很多很多乌鸦...

say:10:1710503008:1.text: If they don't like you, they'll suddenly dive at you.
say:10:1710503008:1.source_cn: 那些乌鸦要是看你不顺眼，可能会突然俯冲下来攻击你。
say:10:1710503008:1.male: If they don't like you, they'll suddenly dive at you.
say:10:1710503008:1.female: If they don't like you, they'll suddenly dive at you.

say:11:1710503009:1.text: Oh! You should buy some lavender! Crows hate the smell and won't come near it.

say:12:1710503010:0.text: Or, if you're offering flowers at a grave, white chrysanthemums are best for mourning.
say:12:1710503010:0.source_cn: 或者您是要给墓碑献花的话，白菊最合适，代表对逝者的哀思。

say:12:1710503010:0.female: Or, if you're offering flowers at a grave, white chrysanthemums are best for mourning.

say:15:1710503012:0.text: Thank you! Keep it close on you and the crows won't dare come close!
say:15:1710503012:0.source_cn: 谢谢惠顾！记得把薰衣草带在身上，乌鸦就不会靠近您啦！

choice:14:0:1.female: I'll take a bundle of lavender.

say:17:1710503013:0.text: Please come again! And be careful, those crows can be vicious.
say:17:1710503013:0.source_cn: 欢迎下次再来！不过您还是要小心那些乌鸦哦，它们可凶了！

say:18:1710503014:0.text: Alright... take care, then. I hope everything goes well for you!
say:18:1710503014:0.source_cn: 好吧……那您自己多加小心！祝您一切顺利！
